result.question: Qual o total e o percentual de internações por doenças respiratórias (CID J%) em cada trimestre do ano no estado do RS?
result.gold_sql: SELECT t.trimestre, COUNT(*) AS total_respiratorio, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_anual FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d JOIN tempo t ON i."DT_INTER" = t.data WHERE i."DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'J%' AND mu.estado = 'RS' GROUP BY t.trimestre ORDER BY t.trimestre;
result.generated_sql: SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM i."DT_INTER") AS trimestre, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AND "MUNIC_RES" IN (SELECT "codigo_6d" FROM municipios WHERE "estado" = 'RS')), 0), 2) AS proporcao FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE c."CID" LIKE 'J%' AND i."MUNIC_RES" IN (SELECT "codigo_6d" FROM municipios WHERE "estado" = 'RS') GROUP BY c."CD_DESCRICAO", trimestre ORDER BY trimestre, total DESC;
